Section 3: Sore Throat & Cough Relief Interventions
Mild cough and throat irritation can be managed with non-pharmacological
comfort steps. Supportive Care Measures: - Warm Salt Water Gargle:
Dissolve 1/2 teaspoon of salt in warm water and gargle 2-3 times daily to
relieve throat soreness. - Honey (for adults and children over 1 year):
1-2 teaspoons of natural honey can soothe cough fits. Never give honey to
infants under 1 year due to botulism risk. - Elevating the Head: Use an
extra pillow during sleep to reduce nighttime coughing caused by
post-nasal drip.
